- **Two rollbacks:** `billing-api` and `pricing-svc`. The first rollback landed on a release that was also degraded.
- **Left alone:** `notify-worker`. Its only earlier release, r-2, was created on 2026-09-01, before the 2026-09-10 cutoff.

The other five `prod` services were already healthy, so I didn't touch them. I made no deployments and didn't touch `staging`.

I wrote `/app/rollback-report.json` with the commit now live for each of the eight rolled-back services and `needs_attention` set to `["notify-worker"]`. I also wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `partial`. Both files parse as valid JSON.
